label: TEHDAS2 D7.2 — Guideline on data minimisation, pseudonymisation, anonymisation and synthetic data
note: European guidance grouping the main data protection techniques together. Written for the EHDS, but the underlying concepts are GDPR-based and apply in the UK.

label: The Five Safes: data privacy at ONS
note: The origin of Safe People, Projects, Settings, Data and Outputs — the framework behind many of the tags used in this ontology.

label: SATRE — Standard Architecture for Trusted Research Environments
note: A community specification for what a trusted research environment should provide, organised around information governance, technical security, data management and supporting capabilities.

label: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
note: The original paper defining Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable.

label: PEDRI — Public Engagement in Data Research Initiative
note: Standards for transparent and inclusive public engagement and involvement in data research.
